## Evidence
Attach logs, screenshots, test output, request/response samples, or minimal reproduction with secrets removed.

## Security note
If this issue exposes credentials, private data, authorization bypass, exploitable security behavior, or sensitive implementation detail, do not publish the exploit details in a public issue. Use the repository's private security-reporting path instead.

## Checklist
- [ ] Reproduction is minimal and deterministic where possible.
- [ ] Sensitive values have been redacted.
- [ ] Related issues/PRs are linked.
